About

An anti-ageing serum for mature skin that reduces age spots and helps prevent their reappearance, plumps deep wrinkles and improves skin elasticity.
NART: 83566-09900-11

Read more about our product

A deep wrinkle serum to reduce age spots, inspired by dermatological treatments, Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity 3D Serum is a lightweight, moisturising anti-ageing serum that effectively targets the three dimensions of skin ageing: 

1. Age spots: The formula contains Thiamidol. Unique to Eucerin, Thiamidol targets the root cause of hyperpigmentation and is clinically proven to reduce age spots and, with regular use, helps prevent their reappearance. 

2. Wrinkles: As skin ages, wrinkles deepen. An innovative blend of high and low molecular hyaluronic acid visibly plumps deep wrinkles. High molecular hyaluronic acid works to smooth the outer layers of the skin, while low molecular hyaluronic acid (which is 40 times smaller*) penetrates deeper into the epidermal layers where deeper wrinkles originate. 

3. Loss of elasticity: Hyaluronic acid in the formula helps to improve skin elasticity. Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity 3D Serum is clinically and dermatologically proven to reduce age spots, visibly plump deep wrinkles, improve elasticity and leave skin looking and feeling radiant and rejuvenated. 

*Compared to the high molecular hyaluronic acid also used in the formula.

How to Use

For best results, apply as the first step in your routine, morning and evening, to a thoroughly cleansed face. Do not exceed four applications per day of all face products containing Thiamidol.

Clinical Formula

Collagen Elastin Complex
The new Collagen-Elastin Complex, a powerful combination of Arctiin and Creatine, re-energizes collagen production and increases skin’s elasticity.
Learn More
Creatine

Creatine is a natural acid produced by the kidneys and liver and mostly stored in the muscle cells. It can also come from your diet. Creatine supports the storage and transport of energy in the human body: muscle cells store energy in the form of Creatine Phosphate and it is transported to tissue with high energy demands such as hair follicles.

Learn More
Hyaluronic acid

Hyaluronic Acid is formed by skin cells and is part of the connective tissue of the skin. One of its key functions is to retain moisture, and it has the ability to bind in between 1,000 and 10,000 times its own weight in water (i.e. one gram binds between one and ten liters). As we age, the skin's natural ability to produce Hyaluronic Acid depletes and wrinkles start to form and deepen.

Learn More
Thiamidol

Thiamidol is a patented ingredient, known to fight hyperpigmentation acting at its root cause. It works by inhibiting the human tyrosinase, the key enzyme in melanin production. Hyperpigmentation can be the result of different causes, e.g. sun-induced dark spots, post-blemish marks or age spots. Key benefits are:

Reduction of Hyperpigmentation: By effectively inhibiting tyrosinase, Thiamidol decreases melanin synthesis, leading to a visible reduction in dark spots and an even skin tone.

Works on all skin types: Thiamidol is dermatologically tested and suitable for all skin types, including dry, oily, combination, normal and sensitive skin. It works for skin of any ethnicity or age and thus is effective on all skin types and tones.

Fights post-blemish marks: Post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation happens when skin is inflamed or injured, for example because of blemishes. The impacted area is left darkened and hyperpigmented despite having otherwise healed. Thiamidol addresses these areas resulting in an even skin tone.

FAQ

Can I use Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity 3D Serum instead of a moisturiser?

The serum contains both high and low molecular Hyaluronic Acid which improves skin moisturisation, but it has not been formulated to replace a day or night moisturiser or a dedicated eye cream. For best results we recommend that you use it in combination with the other products in the Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity range.

Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity 3D Serum does not protect skin from the sun. As the sun’s rays are a key contributor to dark spots, and other signs of skin aging, it’s important to wear an appropriate sun protection product, even on cloudy days. We recommend either Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity Day SPF 30 or SPF 15 depending on the weather and your preferences. Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity Eye also offers SPF 15 as well as UVA protection.

For intense sun exposure choose a higher protection factor from the Eucerin sun protection range such as Eucerin Sun Fluid Pigment Control SPF 50 which also contains Thiamidol and works to reduce dark spots.

What are dark spots and what causes them?

Dark spots (also known as sun spots) are a common form of hyperpigmentation and appear as small, flat, darkened patches of skin that range from light brown to black in colour. They are most common in people over 40, but can occur earlier. 

They are caused by increased production of melanin – the natural pigment that gives skin its colour. Melanin acts as the skin’s natural sunscreen, but excessive sun exposure increases the amount of melanin produced. As the alternative name “sun spots” suggests, they are often triggered by overexposure to the sun. You can find out more about them in “What causes age spots and how can I reduce them?”.

How do I know if Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity is the right anti-age range for me?

Facial skin is more exposed to the sun than skin on the body and is vulnerable to harmful UVA and UVB rays, which can cause photoageing (premature skin ageing caused by the sun). It is important to protect the skin to help prevent DNA damage and hyperpigmentation, so our day cream includes SPF 15 with built-in UVA and UVB protection. 

If you would like all the benefits of our day cream for skin showing signs of ageing, but with higher UVB protection, we recommend Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity Day SPF 30.

How much product should I use?

One pump of product should be enough to cover your face, neck and décolletage, but if you feel you need a little more, that is perfectly fine too.

Will this product improve skin elasticity, reduce dark spots, and plump up deep wrinkles?

Yes. Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity 3D Serum is clinically and dermatologically proven to deliver these results.
